records.name: 20261116083000_harden_bridge_title_owner_helper
statements:
-- Harden the ownership helper used by Production-asset RLS policies.
-- All referenced objects are schema-qualified, so the definer search path
-- can be restricted to pg_catalog only.
--
-- Keep EXECUTE available to authenticated: the RLS policy must call this
-- helper during row authorization. The function returns only an ownership
-- boolean, binds to auth.uid(), and is not executable by anon or PUBLIC.

create or replace function public.bridge_is_title_owner(p_title_id text)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog
set row_security = off
as $bridge_owner$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.bridge_titles t
    join public.bridge_loop_identity_links l
      on l.bridge_user_id = t.owner_user_id
    where t.id = p_title_id
      and l.auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())
  );
$bridge_owner$;

revoke all on function public.bridge_is_title_owner(text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.bridge_is_title_owner(text) to authenticated;

records.name: secure_public_loop_catalog_testing
statements:
DROP FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog();
CREATE FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog()
RETURNS TABLE (
  id text,
  bridge_title_id text,
  slug text,
  title text,
  synopsis text,
  description text,
  content_type text,
  language text,
  year integer,
  duration_minutes integer,
  maturity_rating text,
  director text,
  is_original boolean,
  original_badge text,
  status text,
  listed boolean,
  published boolean,
  featured boolean,
  access_tier text,
  tvod_rental_price numeric,
  poster_available boolean,
  backdrop_available boolean,
  trailer_available boolean
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = ''
AS $function$
  SELECT
    l.id,
    l.bridge_title_id,
    l.slug,
    l.title,
    l.synopsis,
    NULL::text AS description,
    'Film'::text AS content_type,
    l.language,
    l.release_year AS year,
    l.runtime_minutes AS duration_minutes,
    l.age_rating AS maturity_rating,
    NULL::text AS director,
    FALSE AS is_original,
    NULL::text AS original_badge,
    l.status,
    l.is_listed AS listed,
    l.is_published AS published,
    FALSE AS featured,
    l.access_tier,
    NULL::numeric AS tvod_rental_price,
    FALSE AS poster_available,
    FALSE AS backdrop_available,
    FALSE AS trailer_available
  FROM public.loop_titles AS l
  INNER JOIN public.bridge_loop_publications AS p
    ON p.loop_title_id::text = l.id::text
   AND p.bridge_title_id = l.bridge_title_id
  WHERE p.destination = 'CRAYONS_LOOP'
    AND p.authorization_status = 'AUTHORIZED'
    AND p.approved_at IS NOT NULL
    AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND p.window_start IS NOT NULL
    AND p.window_end IS NOT NULL
    AND p.window_start <= now()
    AND p.window_end > now()
    AND p.territories @> ARRAY['WORLDWIDE']::text[]
    AND p.languages @> ARRAY[l.language]::text[]
    AND p.exploitation_models @> ARRAY[l.access_tier]::text[]
    AND l.access_tier = 'TVOD'
    AND l.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PUBLISHED')
    AND l.is_listed IS TRUE
    AND l.is_published IS TRUE
  ORDER BY l.created_at DESC;
$function$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog() FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog() FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog() TO anon, authenticated;

normalize_public_loop_catalog_schema_testing
statements:
DROP FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog();
CREATE FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog()
RETURNS TABLE (
  id text,
  bridge_title_id text,
  slug text,
  title text,
  synopsis text,
  description text,
  content_type text,
  language text,
  year integer,
  duration_minutes integer,
  maturity_rating text,
  director text,
  is_original boolean,
  original_badge text,
  status text,
  listed boolean,
  published boolean,
  featured boolean,
  access_tier text,
  tvod_rental_price numeric,
  poster_available boolean,
  backdrop_available boolean,
  trailer_available boolean
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = ''
AS $function$
  SELECT
    j->>'id',
    j->>'bridge_title_id',
    j->>'slug',
    j->>'title',
    j->>'synopsis',
    j->>'description',
    COALESCE(j->>'content_type', 'Film'),
    j->>'language',
    COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'year','')::integer, NULLIF(j->>'release_year','')::integer),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'duration_minutes','')::integer, NULLIF(j->>'runtime_minutes','')::integer),
    COALESCE(j->>'maturity_rating', j->>'age_rating'),
    j->>'director',
    COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'is_original','')::boolean, false),
    j->>'original_badge',
    lower(COALESCE(j->>'status','')),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'listed','')::boolean, NULLIF(j->>'is_listed','')::boolean, false),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'published','')::boolean, NULLIF(j->>'is_published','')::boolean, false),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'featured','')::boolean, false),
    j->>'access_tier',
    COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'tvod_rental_price','')::numeric, NULLIF(j->>'price_paise','')::numeric / 100),
    NULLIF(COALESCE(j->>'poster_path', j->>'poster_url'),'') IS NOT NULL,
    NULLIF(COALESCE(j->>'backdrop_path', j->>'backdrop_url'),'') IS NOT NULL,
    NULLIF(COALESCE(j->>'trailer_path', j->>'trailer_url'),'') IS NOT NULL
  FROM (
    SELECT to_jsonb(l) AS j
    FROM public.loop_titles AS l
    INNER JOIN public.bridge_loop_publications AS p
      ON p.loop_title_id::text = l.id::text
     AND p.bridge_title_id = l.bridge_title_id
    WHERE lower(p.authorization_status) = 'authorized'
      AND p.approved_at IS NOT NULL
      AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND p.window_start IS NOT NULL
      AND p.window_end IS NOT NULL
      AND p.window_start <= now()
      AND p.window_end > now()
      AND p.territories @> ARRAY['WORLDWIDE']::text[]
      AND p.languages @> ARRAY[l.language]::text[]
      AND p.exploitation_models @> ARRAY[l.access_tier]::text[]
  ) AS authorized_rows
  WHERE upper(COALESCE(j->>'status','')) IN ('APPROVED','PUBLISHED')
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'listed','')::boolean, NULLIF(j->>'is_listed','')::boolean, false) IS TRUE
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'published','')::boolean, NULLIF(j->>'is_published','')::boolean, false) IS TRUE
  ORDER BY j->>'created_at' DESC;
$function$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog() FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog() FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public.loop_titles TO anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public.bridge_loop_publications TO anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.public_loop_catalog() TO anon, authenticated;

statements:
-- Persist title-level operational HOLD / BLOCK independently of lifecycle status.
-- Application writes are server-authoritative; browser roles receive no direct write grants.
create table if not exists public.bridge_title_controls (
  title_id text primary key references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict,
  control_state text not null default 'CLEAR'
    check (control_state in ('CLEAR','HOLD','BLOCK')),
  reason text,
  set_by text,
  set_at timestamptz,
  released_by text,
  released_at timestamptz,
  release_reason text,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint bridge_title_controls_consistency check (
    (control_state = 'CLEAR' and reason is null and set_by is null and set_at is null)
    or
    (control_state in ('HOLD','BLOCK') and length(trim(coalesce(reason,''))) >= 8
      and set_by is not null and set_at is not null)
  )
);

create table if not exists public.bridge_title_control_events (
  id bigserial primary key,
  title_id text not null references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict,
  control_state text not null check (control_state in ('HOLD','BLOCK','CLEAR')),
  action text not null check (action in ('SET_HOLD','SET_BLOCK','RELEASE_HOLD','UNBLOCK')),
  reason text not null check (length(trim(reason)) >= 8),
  actor_user_id text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists bridge_title_control_events_title_created_idx
  on public.bridge_title_control_events(title_id, created_at desc);

alter table public.bridge_title_controls enable row level security;
create or replace function public.bridge_title_buyer_visibility(p_title_id text)
returns boolean language sql stable set search_path = public, pg_temp as $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.bridge_titles t
    join public.bridge_title_gate_certifications g on g.title_id=t.id
    where t.id=p_title_id
      and t.status in ('LIVE_FOR_BUYERS','IN_NEGOTIATION','LICENSED','DELIVERED')
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.bridge_title_controls c
        where c.title_id=t.id and c.control_state in ('HOLD','BLOCK')
      )
      and exists (select 1 from public.bridge_qc_cases q where q.title_id=t.id and q.status='PASSED')
      and exists (select 1 from public.bridge_legal_cases l where l.title_id=t.id and l.status='APPROVED')
      and g.ott_preparation_status='READY'
      and g.packaging_status='COMPLETE'
      and g.curation_status='APPROVED'
      and g.delivery_status='READY'
      and exists (select 1 from public.bridge_destination_packages p where p.title_id=t.id and p.readiness_state in ('READY','AUTHORIZED','DELIVERED'))
  );
$function$;
alter table public.bridge_title_control_events enable row level security;
revoke all on public.bridge_title_controls from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on public.bridge_title_control_events from anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.bridge_reject_title_control_event_mutation()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = pg_catalog
as $function$
begin
  raise exception 'bridge_title_control_events is append-only';
end;
$function$;

drop trigger if exists bridge_title_control_events_no_mutation
  on public.bridge_title_control_events;
create trigger bridge_title_control_events_no_mutation
  before update or delete on public.bridge_title_control_events
  for each row execute function public.bridge_reject_title_control_event_mutation();

revoke all on function public.bridge_reject_title_control_event_mutation() from public, anon, authenticated;

streamvista_legacy_links_unresolved_resolution_state
statements:
create table public.streamvista_legacy_links (
  source_table text not null,
  legacy_id text not null,
  order_id uuid null,
  bridge_title_id text null,
  review_status text not null default 'pending',
  reviewed_by text null,
  reviewed_at timestamptz null,
  resolution_status text not null default 'resolved',
  constraint streamvista_legacy_links_pkey primary key (source_table, legacy_id),
  constraint streamvista_legacy_links_source_table_check
    check (source_table = any (array['accounts_user','films_film','films_filmdraft','films_filmbuyermapping','films_payment','films_status','films_viewhistory']::text[])),
  constraint streamvista_legacy_links_review_status_check
    check (review_status = any (array['pending','verified','rejected']::text[])),
  constraint streamvista_link_review
    check (review_status <> 'verified' or (reviewed_by is not null and reviewed_at is not null)),
  constraint streamvista_legacy_links_resolution_status_check
    check (resolution_status = any (array['resolved','unresolved','rejected']::text[])),
  constraint streamvista_link_target
    check (
      (resolution_status = 'resolved' and (order_id is not null or bridge_title_id is not null))
      or
      (resolution_status = 'unresolved' and review_status = 'pending' and order_id is null and bridge_title_id is null)
      or
      (resolution_status = 'rejected' and review_status = 'rejected')
    ),
  constraint streamvista_legacy_links_bridge_title_id_fkey
    foreign key (bridge_title_id) references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict
);
alter table public.streamvista_legacy_links enable row level security;
